entities.name: Solomon J. Buchsbaum
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Solomon J. Buchsbaum was a Polish American physicist and technologist, best known as chair of the White House Science Council under Presidents Ronald Reagan and George H. W. Bush, and as a senior executive at Bell Laboratories.
